source.description: Fixed varint (LEB128, protobuf-style base-128, least-significant group first) vectors from the spqr crate unit tests for the SPQR V1 message serializer (epoch, key index and chunk index fields). Copied from the test values; the decode vectors give the input bytes, the starting offset, the value and the offset after decoding.
source.upstream_file_path: src/v1/chunked/states/serialize.rs (tests encoding_varint, decoding_varint, decoding_varint_zero; roundtrip_varint is randomized and not included)
